reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for pre-workout, whether that's scoops or milligrams. Products vary a lot in what's in them, caffeine especially, and what's right depends on you, your health, and anything else you take. A doctor or a registered dietitian can tell you what's safe, and the label on your specific product is the starting point for that conversation.

What I can say generally is that pre-workout is optional. Sleep, a solid meal a couple of hours before, and a good warm-up do most of what it does. If you want, I'll build today's session and we can get you moving.
